hero.headline: Every Pitch.

features.headline: The full picture. Every session.
features.subhead: From pitch location to heat zone overlays — every metric a coach or pitcher needs, in one broadcast-quality dashboard.

cards.title: Session History & Trends
cards.description: Track performance across sessions. Spot improvement and mechanical drift over time with visual trend charts.

cards.title: Pitch Location Charting
cards.description: Plot every pitch by location — inside, outside, high, low. Build a complete picture of a pitcher's tendencies.

howItWorks.headline: From mound to insight in three steps.

steps.title: Log Your Session
steps.description: Enter pitch locations manually or connect your device. PitcherML records every pitch — type, location, and outcome.

steps.title: Visualize Pitch Data
steps.description: Instant heat maps and location charts appear after each session. See patterns and tendencies at a glance.

steps.title: Improve With Insights
steps.description: Review session history, share reports with coaches, and track progress over time.

cta.subhead: Join coaches and players already using PitcherML to gain the edge. No hardware required to start.
